# P37/P39/P40 self-service string msgids (generated by scripts/selfservice-msgids.mjs; do not edit by hand). TAB separated: key, en (msgid), he, es, ru.
# Raw strings. TOKENS (resolved per language with the same table on the Site, src/i18n/eaTokens.ts, and on the Control Plane): {until} = the trial END day, short, with the year (Dec 31, 2026); {regShort} = the REGISTRATION close day, short (Dec 24, 2026);
#   {regLast} = the last day a trial can be started, long, UTC (December 23, 2026); {n} = the paid store count of the plan (1 / 3 / 10 from plans.ts); {plan} = the plan name (ss.cta.purchase only); {priceSolo} {priceStudio} {priceAgency} (meta description only). {lastDay} and {regDate} still exist in the token table but no ss string uses them since P40.
# Clocks: registration closes 2026-12-24T00:00:00Z (CP AICC_LM_Trial::REGISTRATION_CUTOFF_UNIX 1798070400; accepted while the server clock is BEFORE it); trial access ends 2026-12-31T22:00:00Z (CUTOFF_UNIX 1798754400). Both are written in UTC only, ONCE per page (the launch panel).
# The two dates are two labelled timeline steps: ss.plan.regLabel + ss.plan.regValue (+ ss.launch.regNote), ss.plan.endLabel + ss.plan.endValue (+ ss.launch.endNote). he times carry U+2066 ... U+2069 (a left-to-right isolate around 00:00 UTC / 22:00 UTC) and a no-break space before it; keep them. Non-breaking spaces (U+00A0) in en/es/ru strings are intentional.
# State -> control (Site src/lib/ssStatus.ts, docs/design/p40-pricing.md 3.3): static/off = ss.cta.soon + ss.state.soonNote (status region, no link); open = ss.cta.start (link /<lang>/start/?plan=<solo|studio|agency>); waitlist = ss.cta.waitlist (same link) + ss.state.waitlistNote; closed_cutoff = ss.cta.closed + ss.state.closedNote; paused = ss.cta.paused + ss.state.pausedNote; after the cutoff with paid purchase open (Control Plane only) = ss.state.closedPaidNote + ss.cta.purchase / ss.cta.choosePlan.
# he/es/ru are machine drafts, not reviewed by native speakers.
